confirmed_contracts.claim: TRAIN=GT-reference; denoiser returns reference+residual; sampler subtracts reference for DDIM residual-state update, then adds reference at termination. No residual-sign mismatch found.
Reference, target, reconciliation and FK agree on local rotation matrix columns0/1, represented as identity-centred6D.
Hidden GT joints remain supervised by x0/raw_x0/FK/global rotation. Observation visibility masks only observation-specific losses and constraints.
TRAIN and current milestone validation share the versioned temporal EXO reference context. Analytical physical guidance isOFF.

confirmed_design_risks.claim: 201D Euclidean additive residual has no localSO3 correction bound or reference-preservation guarantee. It can generate near180deg changes.
Visible knee position does not constrain its own local rotation. With no observed ankle/foot descendants, that knee has exactly zero observationIK strength.

Reference position/rotation features are attenuated by their respective confidence, then tokens by max(position_conf,rotation_conf). Fully hidden joints may be doubly attenuated; visible-knee rotation gets only its own0.05 attenuation because position confidence ishigh.
0.12rad limit bounds only explicit learned-feedback in one x0 call, not UNet residual or wholeDDIM path.
Only selected internal low-rank adapters train; original encoders, feedback readouts and finalposeoutput stay frozen. Capacity limitation ispossible but unproved.

not_yet_proven: No demonstrated rot6d convention, residual algebra, hiddenGT masking or reference-target alignment bug in reviewed path.
No saved internalDDIM intermediates to separate scene effect from denoiser effect.
Toy contracts do not prove actual8k reference preservation or exclude degenerate6D states.

Original requires_grad flags differ between adapter training and top-levelno_grad inference to preserve oldMHA inference numerics; code documents this. No causal evidence this numerical difference creates the large knee fold.
